usedFor: PHP Point Of Sale records sales, and Google Docs logs them through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sale” in PHP Point Of Sale, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each sale adds a line to a document, a simple record you can share with the team.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so choose adding or lose earlier sales.
